method.record_universe: Every retained Wave 04 record. Three committee-reset or categorical-eligibility candidates receive stage-level review; seed-overlap, termination, ordinary-turnover, external-audit, and public-recusal records receive control-level review.
method.chain_rule: provisional_ccd_chain_depth is the deepest uninterrupted documented stage beginning at stage 0; it is null when stage 0 is not documented.
method.furthest_rule: furthest_documented_stage records the most downstream documented stage without bridging an earlier causal gap.
method.temporal_order_rule: A contradiction that first appears after the gate action may be retained as post_action_documented but cannot complete stage 1 of the pre-action K0 chain.
method.member_specificity_rule: Committee-wide conflict, capture, or politicization claims do not establish a bounded member-specific contradiction, reclassification, or explanation mutation.
method.deduplication_rule: Name-blind recovery of a source-ten fixture is a seed-overlap control, not a second event.
method.promotion_rule: No maintainer disposition creates an included K0 event, determines evidence truth, clears publication, assigns psychological motive, or creates a graph edge.

rows.matter: Total reconstitution of ACIP after generalized conflict and capture claims
rows.institution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services / Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

source_packets.supports: Removal of all 17 sitting members, generalized conflict and rubber-stamp rationale, and timing interest in appointing a majority before 2028.
Expert qualification, disclosure, ethics, and public-deliberation requirements.

control_findings: The name-blind query recovered a matter already represented in the source-ten fixture set.
Recovery confirms search reach but cannot be counted as a second event.
The packet still lacks member-specific contradiction, conflict, and reclassification findings for each removed person.
The existing seed fixture remains publication-blocked and independently unadjudicated.

rows.matter: 2021 reset of EPA science advisory committees after criticism of prior membership restrictions
rows.bounded_domain: Reestablishment of Science Advisory Board and Clean Air Scientific Advisory Committee membership
rows.qualification_basis: Institutional scientific-advisory roles were explicit, but the packet does not identify one bounded member whose contradiction drove the reset.

source_packets.supports: Reestablishment of SAB and CASAC membership, criticism of the 2017 grant-recipient exclusion and appointment process, and a stated return to balanced expert recruitment.
Vacatur and remand of the grant-recipient prohibition and EPA's decision not to appeal.

stage_assessments.basis: The 2021 administration stated that the prior grant restriction and appointment process impaired balanced, independent scientific advice.
The packet does not identify a bounded committee member who delivered a qualified contradiction to the 2021 decisionmaker before the reset.
No bounded member's competence, legitimacy, loyalty, or motives are shown being reclassified by the reset decisionmaker.
The generalized critique of the prior process does not establish an explanation-before/explanation-after mutation applied to a qualified knower.
EPA directed reestablishment of SAB and CASAC membership and reopened selection.
Incumbent memberships were ended and the advisory bodies were repopulated through a new process.
Collective membership replacement altered the advisory sensor, but no bounded feedback source and causal removal sequence is established.
Public nominations and later appointments existed, but the packet does not establish an independent pre-action stay or complete remedy for displaced members.

open_requirements: a bounded member-level contradiction delivered before the reset
a member-specific reclassification and explanation-mutation receipt
the exact appointment and removal authority transaction for that member
independent review of whether the matter is better classified as ordinary political reconstitution

rows.matter: 2025 reset and 2026 reconstitution of EPA science advisory committees to reverse alleged politicization
rows.bounded_domain: Reset and repopulation of the Science Advisory Board and Clean Air Scientific Advisory Committee
rows.qualification_basis: The scientific-advisory function is explicit, but the packet does not identify one displaced member and one delivered contradiction.

source_packets.supports: A new nomination process described as reversing politicization of SAB and CASAC.
Selection of a chair and 36 SAB members following the reset.

stage_assessments.basis: The agency stated that the prior boards had been politicized and required reset and reconstitution.
No bounded displaced member's qualified contradiction is documented as reaching the reset decisionmaker before the gate action.
No member-specific competence, standing, loyalty, or motive reclassification is supplied.
The generalized politicization rationale does not establish an explanation mutation after a bounded contradiction.
EPA reopened nominations and later selected a new chair and membership.
The reset displaced the prior committee configuration and installed a replacement membership.
The collective advisory sensor changed, but the packet does not trace removal of a bounded contradictory feedback source.
No complete appeal, stay, restoration, or substitution record is supplied for a bounded member.

open_requirements: member-specific evidence for the politicization classification
a pre-action contradiction reaching a traceable decision surface
a documented reclassification and explanation mutation
an exact account of displaced-member appeal, stay, and restoration routes

rows.matter: Blanket exclusion of current EPA grant recipients from federal advisory committees
rows.bounded_domain: Eligibility of current EPA grant recipients for agency federal advisory committees
rows.qualification_basis: The rule targeted researchers and advisers with current EPA grants; later judicial review supplied a legal contradiction, not a pre-action member-specific epistemic transaction.

source_packets.supports: A rule treating current receipt of EPA grants as incompatible with advisory-committee independence.
Vacatur and remand of the blanket prohibition, with EPA returning to prior policies.

stage_assessments.basis: The directive treated current EPA grant receipt as categorically incompatible with advisory independence.
A federal court later vacated and remanded the prohibition; that legal contradiction postdated the gate action and cannot complete the pre-action K0 chain.
The rule reclassified a funding relationship, but the packet does not document a bounded knower's competence or standing being reclassified after contradiction.
No explanation-before/explanation-after ratchet applied to a bounded member is documented.
EPA imposed the categorical eligibility rule across advisory committees.
Current grant recipients became ineligible and affected committee membership and option sets changed.
The rule excluded a class of potential scientific advisers, but no bounded feedback source and removal transaction is reconstructed.
Judicial vacatur, remand, EPA's decision not to appeal, and return to prior policies supplied later correction.

rows.non_link_reason: The packet establishes categorical eligibility exclusion, consequence, and later legal correction, but not a pre-action qualified contradiction followed by member-specific reclassification and explanation mutation.
open_requirements: a bounded affected member and appointment record
a contradiction delivered before the exclusion was exercised
separation of lawful conflict governance from generalized capture inversion

rows.matter: Termination of the federal human-research-protections advisory committee
rows.institution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

source_packets.supports: The committee's expert function, membership, ethics rules, public process, and stated continuing need.

control_findings: The record establishes termination of an expert body.
It does not supply a capture predicate, qualified contradiction, reclassification, or explanation mutation.
Termination alone therefore cannot be classified as a ceiling-conversion event.
The control preserves an appointment-gate outcome that superficially resembles a purge but lacks the K0 preconditions.

rows.matter: Independent audit of FDA advisory-committee conflict determinations
rows.institution: U.S. Government Accountability Office / Food and Drug Administration

source_packets.supports: Independent review of recusals, waivers, appearance issues, unpublished determination methods, and recommendations for guidance and transparency.

control_findings: An external auditor can inspect recusal, waiver, and appearance determinations without treating all expert relationships as capture.
The control preserves denominators and public reasons outside the committee's own decision chain.
Recommendations do not prove implementation or effective stopping power.
This is counterpower architecture, not a K0 event.

rows.matter: Ordinary staggered turnover and public-input appointment process for a scientific advisory committee

source_packets.supports: Nine new appointments, seven reappointments, staggered terms, public nominations, public comments, and stated expertise criteria.
Four new appointments and six reappointments under staggered terms and expertise criteria.

control_findings: The same appointment gate can operate through staggered terms, mixed renewal, and public input.
Turnover and non-reappointment do not themselves establish purge or epistemic exclusion.
The record does not prove absence of every conflict or political influence.
This comparator prevents total-replacement cases from defining the entire appointment universe.

rows.matter: Published declaration, recusal, and conflict-management architecture for scientific advisory bodies
rows.institution: United Kingdom scientific advisory committee system

source_packets.supports: Regular declarations, publication, prompt updates, and disclosure of financial and nonfinancial interests.
Quarterly review of interests and withdrawal from discussion or decision-making when a conflict is identified.

control_findings: Conflict claims can be processed through published declarations and item-specific recusal rather than categorical exclusion or total replacement.
The architecture separates the conflict decision from the mere existence of professional relationships.
The public packet does not prove that every conflict is detected or every recusal enforced.
This is a structural counterpower control with effectiveness unobserved.
